Dual Delay.TIME: Sets delay length; 0.001-5 s or tempo-synced bars/beats
Dual Delay.FEEDBACK: Percentage of signal fed back into module; 0-100 %
Dual Delay.L/R: Shortens one channel's time or feedback; multiplier 0.10-1.00 (Same at center)
Dual Delay.FREQ: Peak EQ frequency in feedback loop; 20-20,000 Hz
Dual Delay.GAIN: Peak EQ gain in feedback loop; -20 to 20 dB
Dual Delay.LOW CUT: Rolls off low frequencies of wet signal; 20-4,000 Hz
Dual Delay.HIGH CUT: Rolls off high frequencies of wet signal; 1,000-20,000 Hz
Dual Delay.DRY/WET: Balances dry and wet output signal

FX Delay.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Fat Delay.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Ping Pong Delay.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass
Ping Pong Delay.SPREAD: Stereo spread; -100 to 100 %; zero is mono, negative starts left

Simple Delay.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Stereo Delay.LEFT DELAY TIME: Left channel delay length; 0-10 s or tempo-synced
Stereo Delay.RIGHT DELAY TIME: Right channel delay length; 0-10 s or tempo-synced
Stereo Delay.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Gate Reverb.PRE DELAY: Delay before wet signal; 0.01-2 s or tempo-synced
Gate Reverb.GATE TIME: Time until gate cuts decay; 0.05-1 s or tempo-synced

Predelay Verb.PRE DELAY: Delay before wet signal; 0.01-2 s or tempo-synced

Simple Reverb.CUTOFF: Pre-reverb filter; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Rotary.SPEED: Rotary style; options in order: BRAKE, CHORALE, TREMOLO
Rotary.MIC ANGLE: Angle between mics relative to cabinet; 0-180

TalkBox.FILTER MODE: Filter type; options in order: LP, HP, BP

3 Band EQ.LOW GAIN: Low band boost or cut; fixed frequency
3 Band EQ.HIGH GAIN: High band boost or cut; fixed frequency

Rotary Simple.DEPTH: Effect intensity; 1-100 %; high values affect pitch

Rotary Speaker.CROSS FREQUENCY: Crossover between low and high bands; 20-10,000 Hz
Rotary Speaker.DEPTH: Effect intensity; 1-100 %; high values affect pitch

UVI Drive.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

Compressor.RATIO: Slope above threshold; 0-1, lower compresses harder

UVI Mastering.LOW/MID FREQ: Crossover between low and mid bands; 20-20,000 Hz
UVI Mastering.MID/HIGH FREQ: Crossover between mid and high bands; 20-20,000 Hz

Beat Repeat.TIME: Length of repeated section; 0.001-4 s or tempo-synced
Beat Repeat.FADETIME: Fade at start and end of repeats; 0-0.05 s

Redux.TYPE: Resampling style; options in order: DECIMATE, BLOCKER
Redux.QUANTIZE LAW: Quantization algorithm; options in order: linear, mu-law
Redux.FILTER POSITION: Filter placement; options in order: off, pre, post
Redux.FILTER MODE: Filter type; options in order: LP, HP, BP

Robotizer.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass

UVI Destructor.CUTOFF: Filter type and amount; center off, right high-pass, left low-pass
